checks.label: smoke_environment
checks.details: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.

checks.label: initial
checks.reason: At 125 ns, expected state=1 and q=0; initial RTL produced state=0 and q=1.

checks.label: revision_1
checks.coverage: Original waveform at every timestamp, initial unknowns, all eight binary state/input combinations and following rising edges.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Waveform input changes coincident with rising edges are applied as nonblocking stimulus so the flip-flop samples the preceding input values, as indicated by the original trace.

justified_rtl_changes.reason: Original waveform shows mixed inputs preserve state: 65 ns preserves 0 after 10, while 125 ns preserves 1 after 10. Replaced AND update with majority carry update (a & b) | (state & (a | b)). Combinational q remains XOR parity.

justified_tb_changes.reason: Supplementary transition oracle incorrectly assumed AND next-state. Corrected to clear on 00, set on 11, hold on mixed inputs. All original waveform expected values and timestamp relationships retained.

worker_report.interface_cycle_semantics: TopModule with original one-bit ports; one uninitialized positive-edge flip-flop, no reset or extra latency; combinational q.
worker_report.static_review: One sequential driver using nonblocking assignment, no latch, explicit one-bit logic, synthesizable DUT. No synthesis or board work performed.
